mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 3.5%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns due to reduced discount rates and increased risk appetite in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and the Consumer Price Index exceeds 300, the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to the combination of monetary tightening and persistent inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production below 100 (index) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1300 thousand units signals weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales above 700,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 3.5%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 60-day forward returns due to accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations over a longer horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth above 159,000 thousand persons signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 159000.
